name: PageHeader
usage: Title row of a page; on its own when a drawer or a standalone area needs the same title row

props.name: actions
props.description:
Actions on the right: the primary action goes rightmost, as `Button variant="primary"`; the others are default
buttons or IconButtons.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: One sentence of description below the title.

props.name: back
props.description: Back action shown before the title, such as from a detail page to its list.

props.name: titleRef
props.description:
The `<h1>` of the title. It has `tabIndex={-1}`, so it can be focused from code without entering the `Tab`
order: after a client-side navigation, call `titleRef.current?.focus()` so that screen readers announce the new
page and the next `Tab` starts from the top of the content.

types.name: PageBack
types.summary:
The back action of Page and PageHeader: an icon button with an arrow before the title, which goes to the parent
page (from a record to its list). Give `href` for a link, `onClick` for an action, or both for client-side
routing (call `event.preventDefault()` in `onClick`).

fields.name: label
fields.description: Accessible name and tooltip, naming where it goes, such as "Back to projects".

fields.name: href
fields.description: Address of the parent page: the button is rendered as a link (`<a>`).

fields.name: onClick
fields.description: Called on click (and on `Enter`, and `Space` for a button).

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: The primary action goes rightmost; secondary actions go to its left.
